summary: Brand Engagement Network Inc. filed an 8-K/A amending its initial Form 8-K to correct share count in its acquisition of all equity interests of Cataneo GmbH, a German limited liability company. The aggregate purchase price is $19.5 million, comprising $9 million cash and 277,190 shares of common stock. The filing does not state a per-share price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or expected close date, but the acquisition was completed as of June 30, 2026. The transaction is a cross-border private acquisition; watch for integration risks and any post-closing adjustments.
